# Kaique Souza (Kmads)

> Kaique Souza (Kmads) is a Software Engineer in São Paulo, Brazil. He builds backend systems in Java, Go and Python and operates them on AWS, GCP and Azure.

This file is a summary of kmads.dev for language models and agents. The page is in English and in Portuguese (https://kmads.dev/?lang=pt).

## Who he is

- Role: Software Engineer, Architecture & Cloud. He works at PicPay.
- Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil (UTC-3).
- My focus is on backend development, on the architecture of scalable, reliable and performant systems, and on cloud. I have 3 years of engineering experience, but I've been in tech since 2018, and today I work on credit engines at PicPay, impacting over 70 million account holders in Brazil.
- Languages: Portuguese (Native), English (C1), Spanish (Basic).

## Applications in production

- [Consignado Cloud](https://consignado.kmads.dev): One API on two Azure hosts, with each request drawn.
- [Ruph](https://ruph.kmads.dev/): One control plane for every app I run.
- [Diabetes Indicator](https://kmads.dev/diabetes-indicator): Predicts and estimates your risk of diabetes from 17 answers.
- [OffMode](https://kmads.dev/offmode): A Pomodoro timer for deep focus.
- [Notes](https://kmads.dev/notes): A code editor in one HTML file.
- [Doom Offline](https://kmads.dev/doom): Doom in one file, with no server.
- [Agentic Template](https://kmads.dev/agentic): One context for every AI coding agent.
- [Custom Square](https://kmads.dev/custom-square): A CSS playground.
- [TrocaTine Landing Page](https://kmads.dev/trocatine): The landing page of my first startup MVP.

## Study and other projects (source code)

- [Consignado Cloud](https://github.com/kmadsdev/consignado-api): The payroll loan API behind Consignado Cloud: margin check, Price schedule, contract states, optimistic concurrency and a transactional outbox.
- [Simple Payment Gateway](https://github.com/kmadsdev/simple-payment-gateway): A simulated payment gateway for an online store, backend only: authorize, capture and refund with idempotency keys, a double-entry ledger and signed webhooks.
- [Credit Card Engine](https://github.com/kmadsdev/credit-card-engine): A card engine with an acquisition flow for new clients and an upgrade flow for existing clients. One policy module stores each decision with its reasons.
- [DevOps Challenge](https://github.com/kmadsdev/devops-challenge): A distributed system on Docker Compose with 4 containers: a Python writer, a Go reader, a Node.js web front end and Redis between them.
- [Incident Alert API](https://github.com/kmadsdev/software-engineer-challenge-1): A REST API that manages alerts and incidents and exposes the metrics and the health of the application, with MySQL.
- [Engineer Student Tool](https://github.com/kmadsdev/engineer-student-tools): A curated list of the free developer tools and credits in the GitHub Student Developer Pack. A contribution to the community, with no code.
- [Client Potential, HiveMind](https://github.com/kmadsdev/hivemind-client-potential): The page of the HiveMind model: you answer 10 questions, and the model predicts whether the company is a potential client.
- [Legacy Projects, Glitch.com](https://github.com/kmadsdev/glitch-legacy-projects): 24 projects from my Glitch years: Discord bots in Node.js with Discord.js and SQLite, small Express sites with HTML and CSS, and one Minecraft server setup.
